body:
# My Minecraft Modpack

A custom **Minecraft 1.20.1** modpack designed for **performance, visuals, and immersion**.

---

## ✨ Features ✨
- Optimized performance (Embeddium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast, Dynamic FPS, etc.)
- Visual and aesthetic improvements (Fresh Animations, Connected Glass, Continuity, etc.)
- Quality of life mods (AppleSkin, BetterF3, Mouse Tweaks, REI, ShulkerBoxTooltip, etc.)
- Terrain & atmosphere upgrades (Tectonic, Snow! Real Magic, Simple Clouds, Ambient Sounds, Distant Horizons)
- Safe and telemetry-free (No Telemetry)

---
